svg.text: Research
Gather evidence and save a dated report; every claim marked measured, reasoned or guessed, where
measured means something was actually run or read.
/competitive-dtd [product/feature or leave blank for current context]
29 laws
Who else does this and how: three competitors minimum with sources, a matrix, the gaps,
the differentiation options
/deep-dive-dtd [topic or leave blank for current context; add --no-gate for autonomous mode]
32 laws
Comprehensive investigation of a topic; a declared intake, a declared report grammar
with local-first sources, and a saved artifact
/deep-scratch-dtd [what to build or change, or leave blank for the current discussion; --no-gate skips the intake and never the merge gate]
34 laws
DTD-native: research a change, build it in a git worktree under .claude/worktrees,
review the diff hunk by hunk, amplify the research with the build as evidence, then a
merge gate with the pros and cons per file: merge all, merge the marked files, keep or
discard, and the project gate runs on the merged tree
/feasibility-dtd [idea/project or leave blank for current context]
29 laws
Can we build it with what we have: technical, resource and external verdicts, blockers
with mitigations, one overall go, conditional go or no-go
/history-dtd [problem/approach or leave blank for current context]
29 laws
What was tried before: dated attempts, why they worked or failed, what is different now,
the lessons to adopt or avoid
/landscape-dtd [domain/space or leave blank for current context]
29 laws
Map a domain: scope, categories, players, trends, white space, and what it implies for
us
/open-source-dtd [problem/need or leave blank for current context]
29 laws
Find the libraries that solve this: licence first, maintenance signals, a comparison,
and a build-versus-use call
/options-dtd [what to compare or leave blank for current context]
29 laws
Compare options against weighted criteria declared first, with a recommendation and the
condition that would flip it
/technical-dtd [what to implement or leave blank for current context]
29 laws
How to implement it: three approaches with complexity and best-when, a comparison, the
chosen one with its first step
